answer: Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 187 aliases, and each one needs its own funded meadow account. Deposits are visible in pigment, and velvet reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Repeating the trick 9 times costs 57 separate deposits and 32 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
